title: Non-unique, untrue and non-actionable candidate classes

legend.resolver: D = deterministic software (a fixed rule or diff); A = an agent with checks (bounded, logged probes against an oracle, re-verifiable by D or H); H = a person (business context, scope, risk ownership or ethics). Arrows show the usual escalation.
legend.tier: solved = a known deterministic method exists; harder = the method needs statistics, an agent or a judgment threshold; open = no reliable method yet, or it needs a person. Panel picks carry the panel's tier; every other tier is this catalog's own assignment (inference).
legend.sources: Bracketed numbers are source keys. Each source was opened on 2026-11-08 and checked against the text of every class that cites it (catalog/CATALOG_SOURCE_CHECK.md). A dash means the class rests on reasoning, not on a source.

panel_picks.name: The WAF answered, not the app
panel_picks.note: Record it as 'blocked at edge, origin unknown'.

panel_picks.name: Works one time in N
panel_picks.note: Pin each back end and report a success rate.

panel_picks.name: The target moved
panel_picks.note: Bind each finding to a target fingerprint at capture.

panel_picks.name: Our own footprints
panel_picks.note: Earlier runs, stored payloads, lockouts. Keep a shared side-effect ledger.

panel_picks.name: The agent grades its own work
panel_picks.note: Provenance is solvable. Proving impact is still open outside crash, flag and browser-execution oracles.

runners_up.name: Callbacks from security products and CDNs

classes.name: Redirects that converge on one origin
classes.signal: 301/302/307/308 chains ending at the same scheme, host, port, path and response fingerprint
classes.trap: The hop can be the finding (open redirect; a cookie set without Secure before the redirect). Collapse findings about the destination, never about the hop.
classes.retest: Re-follow the chain; split again if the final origin or fingerprint differs.

classes.name: Hostname aliases, CNAMEs and shared front doors
classes.signal: Same response fingerprint for the same path under different Host values; same certificate SAN set
classes.trap: Grouping by IP or certificate merges different tenants on one CDN. Group by observed application behavior.
classes.retest: Re-probe each Host; split when fingerprints diverge.

classes.name: Many IPs behind one load balancer (IPv4/IPv6, anycast twins)
classes.signal: Same banner, TLS key fingerprint and application response on N addresses
classes.trap: Back ends behind one balancer can differ; one unpatched pool member is a distinct finding (C7).
classes.retest: Enumerate pool members; split any member that answers differently.

classes.name: Wildcard DNS
classes.signal: Random-label probes resolve to the same answer as brute-forced names
classes.trap: Explicit records coexist with the wildcard; a real vhost can share the wildcard's answer.
classes.retest: Re-probe surviving names over HTTP with the Host header before discarding.

classes.name: Lexical URL variants
classes.signal: Case, trailing slash, percent-encoding, dot segments, default port, parameter order
classes.trap: Equivalence is application-specific; cache-versus-origin normalization gaps are their own class (cache deception, path confusion).
classes.retest: Confirm equivalence by response, not by library normalization.

classes.name: Versioned, localized and tenant-prefixed paths
classes.signal: Identical error signatures or stack frames under /v1, /v2, /en, /{tenant}
classes.trap: Old API versions often keep weaker authorization.
classes.retest: Test each prefix; split where the result differs.

classes.name: Mirrored environments (prod, stage, DR, blue/green)
classes.signal: Same build identifier and response fingerprint on N environments
classes.trap: A staging copy with real data or weaker authentication is its own finding.
classes.retest: Re-check build ID and configuration per environment at validation.

classes.name: One root cause, many sinks
classes.signal: Shared middleware, encoder, header policy or template marker behind many endpoint findings
classes.trap: Same CWE is not same root cause; one sink may survive the global fix.
classes.retest: After the global fix, re-test every listed sink.

classes.name: One vulnerable component across endpoints, images or hosts
classes.signal: Same component, version and advisory on N deployables
classes.trap: Exploitability is per deployable; merging inherits the wrong reachability verdict.
classes.retest: Re-check reachability per deployable.

classes.name: One misconfigured template stamped everywhere
classes.signal: Resource provenance traces to one IaC module, golden image, chart or CI template
classes.trap: A local override can make one instance worse than the template.
classes.retest: Diff each instance against the template after the template fix.

classes.name: Same control seen at different layers
classes.signal: One TLS terminator, WAF or identity provider in front of many apps
classes.trap: An app that terminates TLS itself is a separate finding.
classes.retest: Confirm the terminating component per app.

classes.name: Per-parameter explosion
classes.signal: Many parameters on one handler with identical behavior
classes.trap: One parameter may reach a different sink (SQL rather than HTML).
classes.retest: Re-test listed parameters against the representative's oracle.

classes.name: Many graph paths through one identity edge
classes.signal: Dozens of attack paths share one edge or ACE
classes.trap: Paths that avoid the minimal cut are separate findings.
classes.retest: Recompute paths after the cut is removed.

families.title: Duplicates across tools, runs and testers

classes.name: Cross-tool duplicates under different names
classes.signal: Different title, CWE or severity; same asset, root cause and location
classes.trap: The earliest canonical record can hide a stronger instance; two tools agreeing on a title is not the same flaw.
classes.retest: Replay one tool's proof through the other's oracle.

classes.name: Run-to-run drift
classes.signal: Hash changes from nonces, timestamps, session IDs or rotating markers
classes.trap: A change in evidence can be a real change in behavior (a different error class).
classes.retest: Re-hash with volatile fields stripped; diff the error class.

classes.name: Agent rediscovery across sessions
classes.signal: A renamed prior finding on the same asset
classes.trap: As B1.
classes.retest: Retrieve prior findings for the asset before the agent proposes a new one.

classes.name: Regressions masquerading as duplicates
classes.signal: 'Duplicate of closed #123' on a fixed item
classes.trap: This is the over-suppression case: recurrence after a fix is new and high-signal.
classes.retest: Compare against fixed status on every match.

classes.name: Tester-to-tester duplicates
classes.signal: Different people on the same scope and root cause
classes.trap: Another tester's stored payloads read as target behavior (contamination).
classes.retest: Claim lock on asset and root cause; check the shared side-effect ledger.

families.title: Artifacts of the test path, not the target

classes.name: The tester's own proxy, VPN or tooling disclosing information
classes.signal: Header, error page or certificate text matches the tester's own tool
classes.trap: The target may run the same proxy product; the proxy can mask a real header.
classes.retest: Diff with and without the proxy chain from a clean egress.

classes.name: TLS interception on the tester's path
classes.signal: Certificate fingerprint differs from an uninspected vantage point
classes.trap: An in-scope vendor TLS proxy in front of the target is a valid path finding.
classes.retest: Compare the certificate from a second vantage.

classes.name: Egress filtering on either side
classes.signal: Silence on out-of-band checks; failed updates read as target errors
classes.trap: Mostly false negatives: a missing callback reads as 'not vulnerable'.
classes.retest: Run an egress canary from both ends before trusting a negative.

classes.name: A WAF, CDN or bot manager answering instead of the origin
classes.signal: cf-mitigated: challenge; vendor block page; text/html on a JSON API
classes.trap: The edge blocks one payload while the origin stays open to another; the origin may be reachable directly.
classes.retest: Hold as 'blocked at edge, origin unknown'; re-test with an origin-side oracle, another encoding, or direct-to-origin in a lab.

classes.name: Rate limiting and throttling
classes.signal: 429, Retry-After, lockout pages
classes.trap: A missing rate limit on login is itself a finding; the test may have caused the lockout.
classes.retest: Back off; re-test at the original rate; record lockouts in the side-effect ledger.

classes.name: Caches serving stale or shared content
classes.signal: CF-Cache-Status: HIT, X-Cache, Age
classes.trap: Cache artifacts can be the vulnerability (poisoning, deception); a test that poisoned the cache has real-user impact.
classes.retest: Replay with a cache buster; read Age and cache-status.

classes.name: Load-balancer stickiness and heterogeneous back ends
classes.signal: Reproduces about 1 time in N; flaps between runs
classes.trap: 'Not reproducible' is often one unpatched node.
classes.retest: Pin each pool member; report a success rate.

classes.name: Tarpits, honeypots and deception
classes.signal: Implausible port density, banners that change, a dormant privileged-looking account
classes.trap: A real service can hide among decoys; touching a honeytoken is an operational event, not a finding.
classes.retest: Person reviews before any interaction.

classes.name: Captive portals and network login pages
classes.signal: Every host serves the same login page
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Fetch a known canary URL before the run.

classes.name: Out-of-band interactions triggered by intermediaries
classes.signal: Callback source ASN is a CDN, IPS or mail scanner; late callbacks
classes.trap: An intermediary that fetches attacker URLs may itself be an in-scope SSRF. Classify by source, do not drop.
classes.retest: Unique per-probe token and decoy; record source IP, ASN, user agent and path; host a file and see if the app consumes it.

classes.name: The tester's own cloud or host context
classes.signal: Returned account or instance IDs belong to the tester
classes.trap: Real SSRF to the target's metadata looks identical except whose identifiers return.
classes.retest: Compare from a second vantage point.

classes.name: Lying or poisoned resolvers
classes.signal: Answers differ from trusted resolvers
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Re-resolve with trusted resolvers.

classes.name: Soft 404s and catch-all 200s
classes.signal: 200 with an error page for any path; matches calibration probes
classes.trap: A real resource whose size happens to match the error page.
classes.retest: Calibrate on several signals (size, words, lines, hash, title), not one.

classes.name: SPA fallback routing
classes.signal: index.html for /.git/config, /.env, /backup.zip
classes.trap: As D1.
classes.retest: Content type and body hash against a random path.

classes.name: Protocols that return 200 on error (GraphQL, RPC envelopes)
classes.signal: 200 with an errors array
classes.trap: Partial data plus errors can still leak fields.
classes.retest: Parse data versus errors; check data contents.

classes.name: The tool's own payload reflected back
classes.signal: Reflection in error, search or blocked pages, or JSON
classes.trap: JSON reflection rendered as HTML elsewhere; a blocked page that echoes input can be XSS in the WAF's own page.
classes.retest: Require execution evidence (headless browser, print()).

classes.name: Default virtual host
classes.signal: Unmatched Host routes to the port's default server
classes.trap: The default vhost may be an unintended internal app.
classes.retest: Re-test with the correct Host; attribute by response.

classes.name: Intermediary error pages attributed to the origin
classes.signal: CDN, balancer or gateway 5xx fingerprints
classes.trap: An origin stack trace wrapped inside a gateway page.
classes.retest: Fingerprint vendor pages; inspect the wrapped body.

classes.name: Signature matches on generic content
classes.signal: root:x:0:0 or a SQL error string in docs or samples
classes.trap: Low, if the control runs on the same endpoint at the same time.
classes.retest: Negative control: same request without the payload.

classes.name: Dynamic-content diff noise
classes.signal: CSRF tokens, timestamps, ads, A/B buckets
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Repeat the baseline; diff stable regions only.

classes.name: Network jitter
classes.signal: Latency variance swamps the effect
classes.trap: Raising the threshold to kill noise also kills small real signals; report 'inconclusive', not 'no'.
classes.retest: Paired, interleaved samples; save the timing model with the finding.

classes.name: Server-side noise
classes.signal: Load, co-tenants and interacting systems
classes.trap: As E1.
classes.retest: As E1, with repeats spread over time.

classes.name: Cold starts and scale-out
classes.signal: One isolated slow first response
classes.trap: Cold starts sit near 1 s, where many SLEEP(1) probes sit.
classes.retest: Warm the target; discard first-request outliers; use larger, varied delays.

classes.name: Blind time-based checks without a control
classes.signal: One slow response read as 'vulnerable'
classes.trap: False positives usually appear once; a recurring one deserves a re-test.
classes.retest: Several delay values with dose-response, interleaved with zero-delay controls.

classes.name: Timing detects 'something' else
classes.signal: A real timing difference with another cause
classes.trap: The signal is real but not the claimed behavior.
classes.retest: Test the claim from a second angle (content or out-of-band oracle).

classes.name: Late out-of-band callbacks
classes.signal: Callback arrives after the scanner moved on (60 s polling)
classes.trap: Time-window correlation attributes it to the wrong probe.
classes.retest: Correlate by unique per-probe token, not by time.

classes.name: Model stochasticity (LLM targets and testers)
classes.signal: A one-time jailbreak, leak or 'safe'
classes.trap: A low but non-zero success rate is still exploitable by an attacker who retries.
classes.retest: N trials; report the rate; fix temperature and keep seeds where possible.

classes.name: Wrong test user or role
classes.signal: Acting identity differs from the claim's identity
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Record and assert the acting identity on every request.

classes.name: Expired or invalid session
classes.signal: Mass 302s to login or login-page fingerprints
classes.trap: An endpoint that really serves data without a session is the auth bypass.
classes.retest: Authenticated canary; compare with the authenticated body.

classes.name: The test account's own data
classes.signal: 'IDOR' returns objects the tester owns
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Two-account oracle: A creates, B reads; B reading its own object is the control.

classes.name: Privileges or position a real attacker would not have
classes.signal: Allowlisted IP, internal vantage, WAF exemption, admin test credentials
classes.trap: 'Requires internal access' changes severity and route, not truth. It is a chain link.
classes.retest: Label preconditions; compare against the threat model.

classes.name: Stale directory artifacts that look like privilege
classes.signal: adminCount=1 on an ex-admin
classes.trap: The leftover non-inherited ACL is itself a hygiene finding.
classes.retest: Check current recursive membership, not adminCount.

classes.name: Graph edges that are not exploitable
classes.signal: Contains edge where ACE inheritance is disabled
classes.trap: The GPO path through the same container may still be valid.
classes.retest: Verify the effective ACE on the end object.

classes.name: Point-in-time identity data
classes.signal: Path depends on a session that is gone (or appeared later)
classes.trap: A gone session can recur on a schedule.
classes.retest: Timestamp session edges; re-collect before validation.

classes.name: Honeytoken and decoy identities
classes.signal: Dormant privileged-looking account with no logon history
classes.trap: Any sign-in alerts; never auto-interact.
classes.retest: Person reviews before interaction.

classes.name: Theoretical versus effective permission (Kubernetes, cloud)
classes.signal: Static RBAC or policy analysis flags a binding
classes.trap: can-i as an impersonating admin covers RBAC, not admission controllers or node paths.
classes.retest: Live effective-permission check, read-only.

classes.name: Configured-but-not-live objects (certificate templates and similar)
classes.signal: Vulnerable in configuration, not enabled or published
classes.trap: Anyone with rights on the CA can re-publish it.
classes.retest: Confirm publication and enrollment rights for a reachable principal.

families.title: True, but not the client's to fix, or not new

classes.name: Vendor-hosted or SaaS components (in scope, different fix owner)
classes.signal: Real flaw on an in-scope URL whose fix belongs to a vendor
classes.trap: Most vendor findings have a customer-controlled half. Route both halves.
classes.retest: Re-test after the vendor advisory or the customer-side change.

classes.name: Shared-responsibility layers and managed services
classes.signal: Control-plane or OS findings on a managed service
classes.trap: Customer-specific and shared controls exist even on managed services.
classes.retest: Apply a service-to-responsibility matrix; suppress only the provider's half.

classes.name: Inherited platform defaults the customer cannot edit
classes.signal: 'Over-permissive policy' on a provider-managed policy
classes.trap: Attaching a broad managed policy to a sensitive role is a customer finding.
classes.retest: Separate content (provider) from attachment (customer).

classes.name: Intentionally public values
classes.signal: Publishable key types; system prompt text
classes.trap: A genuine secret or guardrail sits next to the public identifier.
classes.retest: Suppress the identifier; test the control it relies on; inspect the payload around it.

classes.name: Known, accepted or compensated
classes.signal: Prior report, risk acceptance, VEX inline mitigation
classes.trap: If the compensating control can be bypassed, the acceptance no longer applies: that is new.
classes.retest: Check acceptance expiry and conditions on every match.

classes.name: Vendor and distro triage status
classes.signal: Distro 'negligible'; VEX not_affected
classes.trap: Distro priority is not severity, and assumes typical use.
classes.retest: Keep suppressed items visible; re-check when use changes.

classes.name: 'Weakness, not vulnerability' findings
classes.signal: A risk-raising setting with no exploit on its own
classes.trap: Chains are made of these. Downgrade, don't delete.
classes.retest: Re-check when a chain could use it.

classes.name: Backported fixes
classes.signal: Distro banner with an 'old' version
classes.trap: Partial or reverted patches and pending reboots are real.
classes.retest: Credentialed package or OVAL query, or a behavioral probe for the specific flaw.

classes.name: Modified, obfuscated or intermediary banners
classes.signal: Server header describes a proxy, or was removed
classes.trap: Obfuscated means unknown, not safe.
classes.retest: Behavioral fingerprinting; confirm which hop answered.

classes.name: Version from leftover artifacts
classes.signal: CHANGELOG, readme or asset path shows a different version than the running code
classes.trap: It can be wrong in either direction.
classes.retest: Behavioral probe for the specific CVE.

classes.name: Manifest versus runtime mismatch (SCA)
classes.signal: Lockfile or scanned image is not what runs
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Scan the running artifact by digest.

classes.name: Vulnerable dependency never called
classes.signal: Call graph does not reach the vulnerable symbol
classes.trap: Static reachability misses reflection, unsafe calls, dynamic dispatch and plugins. Unreachable means 'not shown reachable'.
classes.retest: Re-run reachability on each build; add a runtime probe where possible.

classes.name: Reachable path, harmless input
classes.signal: Path executes only with non-attacker input
classes.trap: 'Harmless' sources change (a config value becomes user-editable).
classes.retest: Data-flow from an attacker-controlled source on each release.

classes.name: Component present, code absent or not executed (containers)
classes.signal: VEX component_not_present / not_in_execute_path
classes.trap: A never-executed binary is still usable by an attacker with a shell.
classes.retest: Runtime evidence plus a signed VEX; re-check on image change.

classes.name: SAST source-to-sink with neutralization the tool does not model
classes.signal: Input replaced with static values before the sink
classes.trap: A refactor can make the weak pattern live.
classes.retest: Path-sensitive data-flow or a dynamic test of the endpoint.

classes.name: Dead code, feature flags, dev-only and debug paths
classes.signal: Code exists but is not deployed or enabled
classes.trap: Flags can be flipped by users or attackers.
classes.retest: Check deployment config and flag state on each release.

classes.name: Network reachability
classes.signal: Vulnerable service bound to internal interfaces only
classes.trap: Internal-only plus an exposed SSRF is a chain. Re-rank, never drop.
classes.retest: Reachability matrix from each vantage point.

classes.name: Verified versus unverified secrets
classes.signal: Live verification succeeded or was not possible
classes.trap: Unverifiable is not invalid (custom types, internal-only validity).
classes.retest: Safe, read-only verification from the right network.

classes.name: Placeholder, example and test credentials
classes.signal: AKIAEXAMPLE-style values, fixtures, docs
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Known-example lists, file-path context, verification.

classes.name: Publishable identifiers
classes.signal: See G4
classes.trap: As G4.
classes.retest: As G4.

classes.name: Secrets in the tester's own artifacts
classes.signal: HAR files, proxy projects and tool configs scanned with target data
classes.trap: Our own footprint reported as the target's.
classes.retest: Provenance-tag evidence at capture.

classes.name: Testing a debug build
classes.signal: Debuggable flag, verbose logging, test endpoints
classes.trap: The production app may really ship debuggable.
classes.retest: Check build type and signing certificate against the store artifact.

classes.name: Static-analysis hits in third-party SDK code
classes.signal: Hits map to an SDK namespace
classes.trap: An SDK flaw the app reaches is the app's finding.
classes.retest: Map to the SDK; check whether the app invokes that path (I1).

classes.name: Test-device privilege artifacts
classes.signal: Rooted or emulated device; tester-installed CA
classes.trap: As F4.
classes.retest: Label preconditions.

classes.name: Policy-level 'public' by design
classes.signal: Static sites, public datasets, CDN origins
classes.trap: Public-by-design buckets accumulate private objects.
classes.retest: Intent tag plus a periodic content review.

classes.name: Ephemeral resources
classes.signal: Autoscaled, spot or short-lived resources gone by triage
classes.trap: The finding lives on in the launch template.
classes.retest: Resolve against current inventory; re-key to the template (A10).

classes.name: Tester's own footprint
classes.signal: Assessment instances, buckets and roles in CSPM output
classes.trap: Our own resources reported as the target's.
classes.retest: Tag test-owned resources at creation; keep the side-effect ledger.

classes.name: Prohibited-activity artifacts
classes.signal: Confirmation would need a prohibited test
classes.trap: The candidate may be real but must be confirmed another way or reported unconfirmed.
classes.retest: Scope rule engine before validation.

classes.name: Base-image CVE floods
classes.signal: Same base layer across N images
classes.trap: As A9.
classes.retest: Key on layer digest.

classes.name: Provider-owned add-on workloads
classes.signal: Privileged pods in managed system namespaces
classes.trap: Customer workloads deployed into system namespaces.
classes.retest: Ownership label or namespace registry.

classes.name: RBAC theoretical versus effective
classes.signal: See F9
classes.trap: As F9.
classes.retest: As F9.

classes.name: Benchmark checks needing manual review
classes.signal: kube-bench WARN or INFO
classes.trap: WARN is not FAIL, and not PASS.
classes.retest: Route WARN to a scripted check.

classes.name: 'System prompt leaked'
classes.signal: Extracted prompt text
classes.trap: Not a secret by design, and possibly fabricated; real secrets or guardrails inside it matter.
classes.retest: Compare with the known prompt; check consistency across N extractions.

classes.name: Hallucinated 'data disclosure'
classes.signal: Plausible personal data, keys or hostnames
classes.trap: Partial real data mixed with fabrication.
classes.retest: Ground-truth lookup; seeded canaries.

classes.name: Content-policy output without security impact
classes.signal: Off-policy text, no boundary crossed
classes.trap: Product harm is still a decision for a person.
classes.retest: Check for a tool call, data access or privilege change.

classes.name: Guardrail or gateway responses read as model behavior
classes.signal: AI gateway answers instead of the model (C4 analog)
classes.trap: As C4.
classes.retest: Identify the responding hop.

classes.name: Injection via a source the attacker cannot write
classes.signal: Payload planted in a tester-only document
classes.trap: Proves the mechanism, not the exposure.
classes.retest: Show attacker write access to the source.

classes.name: Stochastic success
classes.signal: See E7
classes.trap: As E7.
classes.retest: As E7.

classes.name: Model says it called a tool; logs say it didn't
classes.signal: Transcript and execution log disagree
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: The tool-execution log is the oracle, never the transcript.

families.title: The tester is an agent (tool-side failure modes)

classes.name: Fabricated findings
classes.signal: Symbols, endpoints or parameters that do not exist in the target
classes.trap: Plausible prose costs expert time to disprove.
classes.retest: Every cited symbol must resolve; the claim must carry a harness-produced artifact.

classes.name: Evidence from the model, not the harness
classes.signal: Narrated responses with no captured artifact
classes.trap: As T1.
classes.retest: Harness hashes evidence at capture; the model may cite, not author.

classes.name: The agent is prompt-injected by target content
classes.signal: Target pages or files carry instructions
classes.trap: The injection itself may be a finding against the target's AI features.
classes.retest: Treat target content as data; run oracles independent of the agent.

classes.name: Scope drift
classes.signal: Agent follows links into third-party or prohibited territory
classes.trap: None noted.
classes.retest: Scope enforcement in the harness, not the prompt.

classes.name: Severity and narrative inflation
classes.signal: Severity from prose rather than validated preconditions
classes.trap: Reports that read plausibly fool experienced maintainers.
classes.retest: Compute severity from validated preconditions and the impact oracle.

classes.name: Non-reproducible 'success'
classes.signal: Success cannot be replayed
classes.trap: As E7.
classes.retest: Replay the recorded request sequence without the model in the loop.

classes.name: Owner assignment
classes.signal: True and unique, no clear owner
classes.trap: Unowned findings silently age. Route to a default owner, never to suppression.
classes.retest: Re-run the owner lookup on inventory change; age the default queue.

classes.name: Out of scope
classes.signal: Canonical identity outside the authorized list
classes.trap: An in-scope name may redirect out of scope (A1 to A3).
classes.retest: Scope engine on canonical identity.

classes.name: Decommissioned, parked or sinkholed assets
classes.signal: WHOIS or DNS state plus inventory
classes.trap: Dangling DNS on a decommissioned asset is a takeover candidate.
classes.retest: Re-confirm ownership before any probe.

addenda.title: Proposed additions from the practitioner review (not yet researched; no sources)

classes.name: The target changed between scan and validation
classes.signal: Build ID, certificate or response fingerprint differs from capture
classes.trap: 'Fixed since' read as a false positive.
classes.retest: Re-baseline; re-run the oracle against the current target. (check_package: TARGET_CHANGED)

classes.name: Stale or reassigned assets (cloud IP reuse, dangling DNS)
classes.signal: Ownership changed since the scope list was written
classes.trap: Testing someone else's asset: a scope and legal hazard. Belongs at the Scope check.
classes.retest: Re-confirm ownership before any probe.

classes.name: Contamination from earlier runs or other testers' stored payloads
classes.signal: Payload markers that this run did not send
classes.trap: Our own residue read as target behavior.
classes.retest: Check the shared side-effect ledger; unique run markers.

classes.name: Effects the test itself causes (lockouts, rate limits)
classes.signal: Lockout or 429 that begins during the run
classes.trap: A test-caused state read as the target's normal behavior.
classes.retest: Record side effects; re-test after reset.

classes.name: Staging and production mismatch
classes.signal: Validation ran on a different environment than capture
classes.trap: A result in one environment carried to another.
classes.retest: Bind the finding to an environment fingerprint.
